question: Who Owns Jack in the Box?
quick_answer: Jack in the Box is an independent, publicly traded company listed on the NASDAQ under the ticker JACK, so it is owned by its shareholders rather than a parent company. It was founded in 1951 by Robert O. Peterson in San Diego, California. The company owned Del Taco from 2022 until selling it in 2025, and had earlier owned Qdoba.
key_facts: Publicly traded on the NASDAQ under ticker JACK
Owned Del Taco (2022-2025) and, earlier, Qdoba

body.heading: Who owns Jack in the Box?
body.text: Jack in the Box is a public company, owned collectively by its shareholders. It trades on the NASDAQ stock exchange under the ticker JACK and is run by its own management and board, not owned by a larger restaurant conglomerate.

body.heading: The brand's roots
body.text: Jack in the Box was founded in 1951 by Robert O. Peterson in San Diego, California. It was an early pioneer of drive-thru fast food, using an intercom and a clown mascot, and grew mainly across the western and southern US.

body.heading: Other brands it has owned
body.text: Jack in the Box has owned other chains over the years. It bought the Mexican fast-food chain Del Taco in 2022, then agreed to sell it to the franchisee group Yadav Enterprises, a sale that was completed in late 2025. Earlier, Jack in the Box also owned the fast-casual chain Qdoba before selling it in 2018. Today it operates mainly as the Jack in the Box brand.

faqs.q: Is Jack in the Box publicly traded?
faqs.a: Yes. Jack in the Box trades on the NASDAQ under the ticker JACK, so it is owned by its shareholders.

faqs.q: Did Jack in the Box own Del Taco?
faqs.a: Yes. Jack in the Box bought Del Taco in 2022 and then sold it to Yadav Enterprises, a sale completed in late 2025.

faqs.q: Who founded Jack in the Box?
faqs.a: Jack in the Box was founded in 1951 by Robert O. Peterson in San Diego, California.
